'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Mercenary, come here for a minute. I have an order of elimination of several groups of PMCs, the highly experienced ones. Sending my soldiers to this would be a suicide mission, so that is why i suggest you to handle this matter. What do you say? As proof of the work done, you have to bring me dogtags from both of these groups.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 55 to start this quest.
* Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

==Objectives==
* Find [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] and hand over 10 [[BEAR]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]] of Prestige 1 or higher to [[Peacekeeper]]
* Find [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] and hand over 10 [[USEC]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]] of Prestige 1 or higher to [[Peacekeeper]]

==Rewards==
*+65,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
*Dollars
**3,216 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
**3,368 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
*1x [[Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan)]]
*Unlock purchase of [[Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan)]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
*+4 levels in [[Pistols]]
*+4 levels in [[Revolvers]]
{{quote|Great, great! The clients have already rewa- uh, thanked us for the successful mission. Good job, mercenary}}
